title: Accounts Administrator
description:
Accounts Administrator

Cambridge £31,500 + Excellent Benefits Permanent

Are you an organised finance professional who enjoys working with numbers, systems and people? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment where accuracy and attention to detail really matter?

We're recruiting for an Accounts Administrator to join one of the University of Cambridge Colleges, supporting the management of student and member accounts.

The Opportunity

This is a varied and rewarding finance administration role with responsibility for billing, fee administration, bank reconciliations, payment processing and financial reporting. Working closely with internal departments and external stakeholders, you'll play a key role in ensuring the accurate management of accounts and the delivery of excellent customer service.

Key Responsibilities
- Preparing and issuing quarterly bills and invoices.
- Processing high volumes of receipts and payments.
- Managing bank account reconciliations and balance sheet reconciliations.
- Monitoring outstanding balances and supporting debt collection processes.
- Maintaining accurate financial records and journals.
- Supporting tuition fee administration and reporting.
- Assisting with year-end audit requirements and financial reporting.
- Producing financial analysis and management information.
- Responding to account queries from a diverse range of stakeholders.
- Identifying opportunities to improve processes and systems.

About You

We're keen to speak with candidates who have:
- Previous experience within finance, accounts administration or transactional finance.
- Strong Excel skills and confidence working with finance systems.
- Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- The ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
- Strong communication skills and a professional customer-focused approach.
- Experience within education, membership organisations or professional services environments would be advantageous but is not essential.

What's on Offer?
- Salary of £31,500
- 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
- Pension scheme
- Private healthcare and dental scheme
- Free onsite lunch
- Employee assistance programme
- Cycle-to-work scheme
- Additional wellbeing and social benefits
- Stable, long-term career opportunity with a respected Cambridge employer.

If you're looking for a finance role that offers variety, responsibility and the chance to work within a highly respected organisation, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now or contact me directly for a confidential discussion.

title: Lettings Administrator

title: HR Coordinator
company: S&B Herba Foods Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Job Title: HR Coordinator

Location: Fulbourn, Cambridgeshire CB21 5 ET

Salary: Competitive

Job Type: Full time, Permanent

Working Hours: Mon - Friday 9am - 5.30pm

About the Company:

S&B Herba Foods Ltd source and import rice and grains (and other raw materials) from across the globe to produce a wide range of ingredients to the specification of UK manufacturers and wholesalers. Our core purpose is to "Feed the nation and be a place where everyone can reach their full potential".

We have just been awarded the Investors In People standard and are embarking on a new era to attain Silver with our ultimate goal Platinum.

In order to do this, we need people that are willing to drive our Goals and Ambitions and continually improve and develop themselves as individuals, with our full support.

Our values are at the heart of everything we do:
- We Before I - We succeed by collaborating and supporting one another
- Proactive - We take ownership, anticipate challenges and find solutions
- Can Do - We approach every task with positivity and determination
- Hungry - We are driven to learn, improve and achieve more every day

If these values resonate with you, we would love to hear from you.

We have been trading for over 100 years and have a great heritage.

Come and join us - it's a great place to work!

About The Role:

We are looking for an enthusiastic, people-focused HR Coordinator to join our team, reporting directly to the HR Manager. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is passionate about people, enjoys variety and wants to build a long-term career in Human Resources whilst helping to create a positive workplace culture.

As our HR Coordinator, you will play an important role in supporting our people, culture and day-to-day operations. This new and varied position combines HR administration, employee engagement and front-of-house responsibilities. Although based at Cambridge, you will also be supporting our Liverpool site.

You will also contribute to our journey towards achieving Investors in People Silver accreditation, helping to shape initiatives that support employee development and engagement.

Key responsibilities include:
- HR administration: Provide comprehensive support throughout the employee lifecycle and maintain accurate, confidential employee records and documentation.
- Recruitment and onboarding: Support recruitment, onboarding and induction activities.
- Engagement and wellbeing: Coordinate employee engagement and wellbeing initiatives, including projects supporting our Investors in People Silver accreditation.
- Learning and Development Coordination: Support the delivery of the Company's learning and development strategy by coordinating training programmes and courses, maintaining training and skill matrices, tracking completion of mandatory and role-specific training, producing training reports, and promoting continuous professional development opportunities.
- Manager support: Assist managers with HR processes, handling sensitive employee information with discretion and professionalism.
- Continuous improvement: Help improve HR processes and support the HR Manager in terms of the service HR provides to the Company at both sites.
- Front-of-house: Delivering a professional front-of-house reception service, acting as the first point of contact for visitors, employees and external stakeholders. This will include the managing of meeting rooms, post and couriers.

About you:

We are looking for someone who:
- Is passionate about building a career in Human Resources
- Has a university degree in Human Resources or a related discipline, or is keen to pursue an HR degree or professional qualification, such as CIPD, whilst working
- Is highly organised and has excellent attention to detail
- Handles confidential information with integrity and discretion
- Communicates confidently and enjoys working with people at all levels
- Is friendly and professional, creating a positive first impression for visitors
- Is proactive, adaptable and able to manage a varied workload
- Is committed to living our company values every day

What We Offer:
- The opportunity to build a rewarding career in Human Resources
- A varied and rewarding role in which no two days are the same
- The opportunity to contribute to meaningful employee engagement initiatives
- A collaborative, supportive working environment shaped by our core values
- The chance to be part of our journey towards Investors in People Silver accreditation

Benefits:
- 22 days holiday (plus bank holidays) increasing each year by one day until a max of 25 days
- Pension Scheme + Life Assurance
- Income Protection
- Free onsite car parking
- Bike to Work Scheme
- Employee Assistance Programme
- Support to pursue further professional qualifications
- Free rice (quarterly)

Please click the APPLY button and to submit your CV and Cover Letter.

Candidates with experience of: Human Resource Officer, Human Resource Administrator, HR Admin, HR Generalist, HR Officer, HR Specialist, Employee Relations Specialist, Employee Relations Advisor, Employee Relations Manager, HR Business Partner, HR Manager may also be considered for this role.

title: Accounts Administrator
description:
Accounts Receivable - Deposit & Payments Role

Role Overview

We are recruiting a highly organised and detail-oriented Accounts Administrator to join our busy Deposit & PaymentsClerk. This is a fast-paced role supporting dealerships across the UK, ensuring customer deposits, credit applications and banking transactions are processed accurately and efficiently.

Working closely with one other team member, you will be responsible for managing high transaction volumes across three bank accounts covering approximately 147 sites. This position would suit someone who thrives in a busy environment, enjoys working to deadlines and has exceptional attention to detail.

Key Responsibilities

Processing and allocating customer deposit payments received from other departments and online forms.

Monitoring and reconciling transactions across three company bank accounts.

Processing and validating credit applications in line with company procedures.

Managing and allocating payments accurately and within agreed timescales.

Investigating and resolving payment discrepancies.

Ensuring all financial records are maintained accurately and updated promptly.

Working collaboratively with colleagues and internal stakeholders to ensure smooth day-to-day operations.

Supporting month-end activities and meeting strict financial deadlines.

Maintaining compliance with company policies and controls.

About You

We are looking for someone who has:

Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.

Previous experience in an accounts, finance, banking or administration environment.

Strong organisational and time management skills.

The ability to work effectively under pressure in a high-volume environment.

Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.

Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.

A proactive and positive approach to problem-solving.

The ability to work independently whilst also contributing to a small team.

Working Environment

Fast-paced, high-volume finance administration role.

Processing up to 25 applications per hour.

During month-end periods, transaction volumes can increase significantly, with up to 300 applications requiring processing in a single day.

Working within a small team responsible for critical financial processes across the network.

What Success Looks Like

Strong management of high transaction volumes whilst maintaining attention to detail.

Effective support to dealerships across the network.

Consistent achievement of month-end deadlines and service levels.

This is an excellent opportunity for an organised and motivated individual who enjoys working in a fast-moving environment where accuracy, efficiency and teamwork are key. Please apply for this role looking to interview this week!

title: Talent Acquisition Coordinator
description:
Talent Acquisition Coordinator

Location: Peterborough
Reporting to: Head of HR

Hybrid: 3 days per week in office

About the Role

We're looking for an organised and proactive Talent Acquisition Coordinator to join our client's HR team and help drive recruitment activity across the firm. This is an exciting opportunity for a recruitment professional who enjoys managing multiple vacancies, partnering with hiring managers, and delivering an outstanding candidate experience.

The Role

As Talent Acquisition Coordinator, you will coordinate end-to-end recruitment campaigns, ensuring vacancies progress efficiently from approval through to appointment. You'll work closely with hiring managers, candidates and recruitment agencies, providing practical recruitment support whilst helping the firm attract and secure top talent.

Key Responsibilities
- Managing recruitment campaigns across a variety of business areas.
- Drafting engaging job adverts, job descriptions and attraction materials.
- Sourcing and attracting candidates through job boards, LinkedIn and professional networks.
- Managing candidate communications and recruitment pipelines.
- Coordinating interviews, assessments and selection activities.
- Building strong relationships with hiring managers and providing recruitment guidance.
- Managing relationships with recruitment agencies and external suppliers.
- Maintaining accurate recruitment data, records and reporting.
- Supporting onboarding and pre-employment screening processes.
- Promoting fair, inclusive and compliant recruitment practices.

About You

We're looking for someone who can bring:
- Experience managing recruitment campaigns within an in-house recruitment or talent acquisition environment.
- Proven candidate sourcing experience across multiple recruitment channels.
- Experience supporting and advising hiring managers throughout the recruitment process.
- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
- A proactive approach and confidence to provide practical recruitment advice.

Desirable
- Recruitment experience within professional services, legal, financial services or another regulated environment.
- Experience producing recruitment resources, guides or training materials.
- Knowledge of applicant tracking systems, recruitment technology and recruitment analytics.

Why Join Us?

You'll join a supportive HR team and play a key role in attracting talented people who contribute to the firm's continued success. This role offers the opportunity to make a real impact on recruitment outcomes, work closely with stakeholders across the business, and help shape a positive candidate experience.

Interested? We'd love to hear from you. Apply today to become part of a growing and collaborative team.

title: Finance Assistant
description:

- Monitor outstanding debt and support credit control and cash collection
- Process and reconcile daily banking transactions
- Assist with month-end close, balance sheet reconciliations, accruals and prepayments
- Support VAT and statutory reporting
- Maintain the fixed asset register and financial records in Xero
- Investigate and resolve financial discrepancies
- Support management accounts, reporting and financial analysis
- Identify opportunities to improve finance processes, controls and reporting

Skills & Experience Essential:

- Good understanding of purchase ledger, sales ledger and bank reconciliations

- Good Excel knowledge
- Excellent organisation and ability to meet deadlines
- Confident communication skills with customers, suppliers and colleagues

Desirable:

- SME experience
- Manufacturing, distribution or product-based experience

description: OPAC Administration Services are recruiting a enthusiastic and motivated Administrators to support the Diabetes Service. The successful candidate will be providing patient focused administration support to a countywide service covering Cambridge, Fenland, Peterborough & Huntingdon liaising with our Nurses and services users to ensure an effective, efficient & streamlined service. The role will be based at our Admin hubs in Huntingdon, Cambourne, Peterborough or Doddington. We currently have 1 full time vacancy, 37.5hrs per week. Please do make contact if you would like to discuss the role further. Please note for this role you will be required to travel independently around the county meeting strict time deadlines The role involves providing comprehensive administrative support to our Diabetes Service. Responsibilities include processing referrals, managing waiting and triage lists, maintaining accurate service user records, and handling correspondence and data across multiple IT systems. The postholder will communicate professionally with referrers, clinicians, and service users, deliver an effective telephone service, coordinate interpreters, and support team operations through scanning, record management, and training of new staff. Please refer to the attached job description and person specification for full details of responsibilities Management and coordination of inbound and outbound communications and correspondence across multiple formats and channels. Responsible for the efficient coordination of appointment scheduling and proactive management of waiting lists to ensure timely access and optimal service delivery. Inputting and updating service user information and service user/team activity on computerised information systems, creating service user notes where necessary and according to policy. Maintain filing in both paper and electronic records, ensuring that it is kept up to date at all times. In accordance with Trust procedures, track and receive notes in a timely manner. Process and triage referrals across multiple pathways, applying specialist knowledge to ensure accurate prioritisation and appropriate allocation in line with service protocols. Effectively manage a high volume of incoming calls while navigating multiple systems and applying specialist knowledge to deliver a professional, responsive, and solution-focused service. Utilise both internal and external partner systems to efficiently manage workload, ensuring tasks are completed accurately, collaboratively, and in line with service standards. Handle telephone-based electronic payments and banking transactions with accuracy and security, ensuring compliance with financial procedures while delivering a professional and customer-focused service. Collect patient feedback to support continuous improvement and ensure the delivery of high-quality, patient-centred services. Manage and process incoming and outgoing mail in accordance with various established postal protocols and organisational procedures, ensuring secure and timely handling of all correspondence. Provide operational support, supervision, training, mentorship and cover to/of colleagues as directed by line manager. Providing a high level of administrative support to our clinical teams, building good professional relationships whilst setting & ensuring remit boundaries.
